title: Security and Safety Management in Hospitality

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the role and significance of ensuring security and safety in hospitality management.
Analyze factors affecting the establishment of security systems in hotels and components of hotel security systems.
Apply procedures for ensuring guest safety in hotels.
Implement procedures for ensuring security at various departments within hotels.
Perform proficient operations in security services in hotels.
Apply leadership and management skills in hotel security management.
Identify health requirements, ethical standards, and safety regulations for hotel security personnel.
Demonstrate a sense of responsibility, honesty, seriousness, and discipline in work.
Maintain proper conduct, politeness, and appropriate behavior.
Manage risks and respond to emergency situations in hotels.
